source.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁמַ֤ע אֶל־הַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְאֶל־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָֽנֹכִ֛י מְלַמֵּ֥ד אֶתְכֶ֖ם לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת לְמַ֣עַן תִּֽחְי֗וּ וּבָאתֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the judgments that I [am] teaching you to do, so that you may live and go in and take possession of the land that Yahweh, [the] God of your fathers, [is] giving to you.

en.L: And now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the judgments that I [am] teaching you to do, so that you may live, and go in and take possession of the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, [the] God of your fathers, [is] giving you.
en.B: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and rulings that I am teaching you to put into practice. Then you will live, and you will enter and take possession of the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of your ancestors, is giving you.
en.R: Now, Israel, listen to the laws and rules I am teaching you, and obey them. Then you will live, and you will go in and take possession of the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of your ancestors, is giving you.

es.L: Y ahora, Israel, escucha los estatutos y los juicios que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} enseño a hacer, para que {{plural_you:vivan|viváis}} y {{plural_you:entren|entréis}} y {{plural_you:tomen|toméis}} posesión de la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, [el] Dios de {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} da.
es.B: Ahora, Israel, escucha los estatutos y las normas que {{plural_you:les|os}} enseño para que los {{plural_you:pongan|pongáis}} en práctica. Así {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}}, y {{plural_you:entrarán|entraréis}} y {{plural_you:tomarán|tomaréis}} posesión de la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} da.
es.R: Ahora, Israel, escucha las leyes y las normas que {{plural_you:les|os}} estoy enseñando, para que {{plural_you:las obedezcan|las obedezcáis}}. Así {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}}, y {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} entrar y tomar posesión de la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} está dando.

fr.L: Et maintenant, Israël, écoute les prescriptions et les jugements que je vous enseigne à pratiquer, afin que vous viviez, et que vous entriez et preniez possession du pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [le] Dieu de vos pères, vous donne.
fr.B: Maintenant, Israël, écoute les prescriptions et les règles que je vous enseigne pour que vous les mettiez en pratique. Alors vous vivrez, et vous entrerez et prendrez possession du pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de vos ancêtres, vous donne.
fr.R: Maintenant, Israël, écoute les lois et les règles que je vous enseigne, pour que vous leur obéissiez. Alors vous vivrez, et vous pourrez entrer dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de vos ancêtres, vous donne, et en prendre possession.

sw.L: Na sasa, Israeli, sikiliza kanuni na hukumu ambazo mimi ninawafundisha kuzitenda, ili mpate kuishi, na kuingia na kuimiliki nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa baba zenu, anawapa.
sw.B: Sasa, Israeli, sikiliza kanuni na maagizo ninayowafundisha, ili mpate kuyatenda. Ndipo mtaishi, na mtaingia na kuimiliki nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa mababu zenu, anawapa.
sw.R: Sasa, Israeli, sikiliza sheria na maagizo ninayowafundisha, kisha myatii. Ndipo mtaishi, na mtaingia katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa mababu zenu, anawapa, na kuimiliki.

ko.L: 그러므로 이제 이스라엘아, 내가 너희에게 가르쳐 행하게 하는 규례와 법도를 들어라. 그러면 너희가 살고, 너희 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 주시는 땅에 들어가 그것을 차지할 것이다.
ko.B: 이제 이스라엘아, 내가 너희에게 가르쳐 지키게 하는 규례와 법도를 잘 들어라. 그러면 너희가 살 것이고, 너희 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 주시는 땅에 들어가 그 땅을 차지할 것이다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 여러분, 이제 제가 여러분에게 가르치는 법과 규칙을 잘 듣고 지키십시오. 그러면 여러분이 살 것이고, 여러분 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분에게 주시는 땅에 들어가 그 땅을 차지할 것입니다.

vi.L: Và bây giờ, hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy nghe các luật lệ và các mạng lệnh mà tôi dạy các ngươi để làm theo, hầu cho các ngươi được sống, được vào và chiếm hữu xứ mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của cha ông các ngươi, ban cho các ngươi.
vi.B: Bây giờ, hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy lắng nghe các luật lệ và mạng lệnh mà tôi dạy anh em để làm theo. Như vậy anh em sẽ được sống, được vào và chiếm hữu xứ mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên anh em, đang ban cho anh em.
vi.R: Bây giờ, hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy lắng nghe những luật lệ và quy tắc tôi đang dạy anh em, và hãy vâng giữ. Như vậy anh em sẽ được sống, sẽ vào và chiếm lấy xứ mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên anh em, đang ban cho anh em.

pt.L: E agora, Israel, ouve os estatutos e as ordenanças que eu estou ensinando a vocês para [os] praticarem, a fim de que vivam, e entrem e tomem posse da terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, [o] Deus dos pais de vocês, dá a vocês.
pt.B: Agora, Israel, ouve os estatutos e as ordenanças que estou ensinando para serem postos em prática. Então vocês viverão, entrarão e tomarão posse da terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos antepassados de vocês, está dando a vocês.
pt.R: Agora, Israel, ouve as leis e as regras que estou ensinando e obedece a elas. Então vocês vão viver. Vão entrar e tomar posse da terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos antepassados de vocês, está dando a vocês.

am.L: አሁንም እስራኤል ሆይ፣ በሕይወት ትኖሩ ዘንድ፣ ገብታችሁም የአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚሰጣችሁን ምድር ትወርሱ ዘንድ፣ ታደርጓቸው ዘንድ የማስተምራችሁን ሥርዓቶችና ፍርዶች ስማ።
am.B: አሁንም እስራኤል ሆይ፣ በሥራ ላይ እንድታውሏቸው የማስተምራችሁን ሥርዓቶችና ደንቦች ስማ። ያን ጊዜ በሕይወት ትኖራላችሁ፤ ገብታችሁም የቀድሞ አባቶቻችሁ አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚሰጣችሁን ምድር ትወርሳላችሁ።
am.R: አሁንም እስራኤል ሆይ፣ የማስተምራችሁን ሥርዓቶችና ሕጎች አድምጥ፤ ፈጽሟቸውም። ያን ጊዜ በሕይወት ትኖራላችሁ፤ ገብታችሁም የቀድሞ አባቶቻችሁ አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚሰጣችሁን ምድር የራሳችሁ ታደርጋላችሁ።

hi.L: और अब, हे इस्राएल, उन विधियों और नियमों को सुनो जिन्हें मैं तुम्हें मानने के लिए सिखा रहा [हूँ], ताकि तुम जीवित रहो, और जाकर उस देश पर अधिकार कर लो जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तुम्हारे पितरों के परमेश्वर, तुम्हें दे रहे [हैं]।
hi.B: अब, हे इस्राएल, उन विधियों और नियमों को सुनो जो मैं तुम्हें सिखा रहा हूँ कि तुम उनका पालन करो। तब तुम जीवित रहोगे, और जाकर उस देश पर अधिकार कर लोगे जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तुम्हारे पूर्वजों के परमेश्वर, तुम्हें दे रहे हैं।
hi.R: अब, हे इस्राएल, उन विधियों और नियमों को सुनो जो मैं तुम्हें सिखा रहा हूँ, और उनका पालन करो। तब तुम जीवित रहोगे, और तुम जाकर उस देश को अपना बना लोगे जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तुम्हारे पूर्वजों के परमेश्वर, तुम्हें दे रहे हैं।

ru.L: И теперь, Израиль, слушай установления и правила, которым я учу вас, чтобы исполнять [их], чтобы вы жили, и вошли, и овладели землёй, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, Бог ваших отцов, даёт вам.
ru.B: А теперь, Израиль, слушай установления и правила, которым я учу вас, чтобы вы исполняли их. Тогда вы будете жить, войдёте и овладеете землёй, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, Бог ваших {{gender:предков|отцов}}, даёт вам.
ru.R: А теперь, Израиль, слушай законы и правила, которым я вас учу, и исполняй их. Тогда вы будете жить, войдёте в землю, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, Бог ваших {{gender:предков|отцов}}, даёт вам, и овладеете ею.

ja.L: そして今、イスラエルよ、わたしがあなたがたに教えて行わせようとしている定めと掟に聞きなさい。そうすれば、あなたがたは生き、入って行って、あなたがたの先祖たちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたがたに与えようとしておられる地を所有することができる。
ja.B: 今、イスラエルよ、わたしがあなたがたに教える定めと掟を聞き、それを行いなさい。そうすれば、あなたがたは生きて、あなたがたの先祖の神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が与えようとしておられる地に入り、それを所有することができる。
ja.R: さあ、イスラエルよ、わたしが教えるきまりとおきてを聞いて、それを守りなさい。そうすれば、あなたたちは生きることができる。そして、あなたたちの先祖の神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が与えようとしておられる地に入り、それを自分たちのものにすることができる。

uk.L: А тепер, Ізраїлю, слухай постанов і правил, яких я навчаю вас, щоб виконувати, щоб ви жили, і ввійшли, і заволоділи краєм, який {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, Бог ваших батьків, дає вам.
uk.B: Тепер, Ізраїлю, слухай постанови й правила, яких я навчаю вас, щоб ви їх виконували. Тоді ви житимете, ввійдете й заволодієте краєм, який {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, Бог ваших предків, дає вам.
uk.R: Тепер, Ізраїлю, слухай закони й правила, яких я вас навчаю, і виконуйте їх. Тоді ви житимете, ввійдете в край і заволодієте ним. Цей край дає вам {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, Бог ваших предків.

id.L: Dan sekarang, hai Israel, dengarkanlah ketetapan-ketetapan dan peraturan-peraturan yang aku ajarkan kepada kalian untuk dilakukan, supaya kalian hidup dan masuk dan menduduki negeri yang diberikan kepada kalian oleh {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah nenek moyang kalian.
id.B: Sekarang, hai Israel, dengarkanlah ketetapan dan peraturan yang aku ajarkan kepada kalian untuk dilakukan. Dengan begitu kalian akan hidup, dan kalian akan masuk dan menduduki negeri yang diberikan kepada kalian oleh {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah nenek moyang kalian.
id.R: Sekarang, hai Israel, dengarkanlah hukum dan peraturan yang aku ajarkan kepada kalian, dan taatilah semuanya. Dengan begitu kalian akan hidup, dan kalian akan masuk dan merebut negeri yang diberikan kepada kalian oleh {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah nenek moyang kalian.

zh.L: 现在，以色列啊，你要听我教导你们要遵行的律例和典章，使你们可以活着，并进去得{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们列祖的{{god_term:神|上帝}}正赐给你们的地为业。
zh.B: 以色列啊，现在你们要听从我教导你们去遵行的律例和规定。这样，你们就能存活，并且能进去占领{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们祖先的{{god_term:神|上帝}}要赐给你们的地。
zh.R: 以色列人哪，现在你们要听我教导你们的律例和规定，并且要遵守。这样你们就能活下去，可以进去，把{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们祖先的{{god_term:神|上帝}}要赐给你们的地据为己有。

tl.L: At ngayon, O Israel, makinig ka sa mga tuntunin at mga batas na itinuturo ko sa inyo upang gawin, upang kayo ay mabuhay, at pumasok at angkinin ang lupaing ibinibigay sa inyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, [ang] Diyos ng inyong mga ama.
tl.B: Ngayon, Israel, pakinggan ninyo ang mga tuntunin at mga batas na itinuturo ko sa inyo upang inyong isagawa. Sa gayon ay mabubuhay kayo, at papasok kayo at aangkinin ang lupaing ibinibigay sa inyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, ang Diyos ng inyong mga ninuno.
tl.R: Ngayon, Israel, pakinggan ninyo ang mga batas at mga tuntuning itinuturo ko sa inyo, at sundin ninyo ang mga ito. Sa gayon ay mabubuhay kayo, at papasok kayo at aangkinin ang lupaing ibinibigay sa inyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}}, ang Diyos ng inyong mga ninuno.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਹੁਣ, ਹੇ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਬਿਧੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਣ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਪਾਲਣ ਲਈ ਸਿਖਾਉਂਦਾ [ਹਾਂ], ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜੀਉਂਦੇ ਰਹੋ, ਅਤੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਉਸ ਦੇਸ਼ ਉੱਤੇ ਕਬਜ਼ਾ ਕਰੋ ਜਿਹੜਾ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}}, ਤੁਹਾਡੇ {{gender:ਵੱਡ-ਵਡੇਰਿਆਂ|ਪਿਉ-ਦਾਦਿਆਂ}} ਦੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ, ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ [ਹਨ]।
pa.B: ਹੁਣ, ਹੇ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ, ਉਹ ਬਿਧੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਆਂ ਸੁਣੋ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਅਮਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਿਆਉਣ ਲਈ ਸਿਖਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹਾਂ। ਤਦ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜੀਉਂਦੇ ਰਹੋਗੇ, ਅਤੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਉਸ ਦੇਸ਼ ਉੱਤੇ ਕਬਜ਼ਾ ਕਰੋਗੇ ਜਿਹੜਾ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}}, ਤੁਹਾਡੇ {{gender:ਵੱਡ-ਵਡੇਰਿਆਂ|ਪਿਉ-ਦਾਦਿਆਂ}} ਦੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ, ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ।
pa.R: ਹੇ ਇਸਰਾਏਲ, ਹੁਣ ਉਹ ਨਿਯਮ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਨੂੰਨ ਸੁਣੋ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਸਿਖਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹਾਂ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਮੰਨੋ। ਤਦ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜੀਉਂਦੇ ਰਹੋਗੇ, ਅਤੇ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਉਹ ਦੇਸ਼ ਆਪਣਾ ਬਣਾ ਲਓਗੇ ਜਿਹੜਾ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}}, ਤੁਹਾਡੇ {{gender:ਵੱਡ-ਵਡੇਰਿਆਂ|ਪਿਉ-ਦਾਦਿਆਂ}} ਦੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ, ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ।

decisions.choice: And now: the turn from what has happened to what Israel must do
decisions.reason: Chapters 1-3 retell the journey from Horeb to the plains of Moab. "And now" draws the lesson from that history: the God who has led them this far calls them to listen and obey. The rest of chapter 4 is the close of Moses' first speech.

decisions.choice: statutes and judgments: the whole body of God's law
decisions.reason: The two words are often paired in Deuteronomy (4:5, 8, 14; 5:1; 12:1). The first is a fixed rule or decree; the second a ruling, a decision about what is right in a case. Together they name everything Moses is about to teach.

decisions.choice: so that you may live: life in the land comes with obedience
decisions.reason: To live is more than to survive. It is the full life God gives his people in the land, and Deuteronomy ties it again and again to listening to him (4:4, 40; 30:15-20). The verse sets life before them as the goal of the law.

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "fathers" means the forebears of the people, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob and those after them. Balanced and Readable say "ancestors"; Literal keeps "fathers".

decisions.choice: Then you will live
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable split the long sentence and make the result of obeying a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: "los estatutos y los juicios" (L); "los estatutos y las normas" (B); "las leyes y las normas" (R)
decisions.reason: For Deuteronomy's recurring pair (4:1, 5, 8, 14; 5:1; 12:1). Literal keeps "juicios" for mishpatim, as the English keeps "judgments"; Balanced and Readable say "normas", the word the Pentateuch terms list uses for a rule, so that "mandamientos" stays for the commandments.

decisions.choice: "les prescriptions et les jugements" (L); "les prescriptions et les règles" (B); "les lois et les règles" (R)
decisions.reason: For Deuteronomy's recurring pair (4:1, 5, 8, 14; 5:1; 12:1), as the Pentateuch terms list and Exodus 21:1 have them: Literal keeps "jugements" for mishpatim, as the English keeps "judgments"; Balanced says "règles"; Readable follows the English "laws and rules".

decisions.choice: "kanuni na hukumu" (L); "kanuni na maagizo" (B); "sheria na maagizo" (R)
decisions.reason: For Deuteronomy's recurring pair (4:1, 5, 8, 14; 5:1; 12:1), as the Pentateuch terms list and Exodus 21:1 have them: Literal keeps "hukumu" (judgments) for mishpatim; Balanced says "maagizo"; Readable follows the English "laws and rules". "Amri" stays for the commandments (mitsvot).

decisions.choice: "luật lệ" for statutes; "mạng lệnh" (L, B), "quy tắc" (R) for judgments
decisions.reason: The term sheet's words for the pair, which together mean the whole of God's law (meaning decision); Readable uses the everyday "quy tắc" for rulings, as the English Readable says "rules". Used through the book.

decisions.choice: "규례와 법도" (Literal, Balanced) and "법과 규칙" (Readable) for "statutes and judgments"
decisions.reason: The term sheet sets "규례" for statute and "법도" for mishpat; Readable uses everyday words, as the English Readable says "laws and rules", since both church words are unfamiliar to new readers.

decisions.choice: tu where the Hebrew "you" is singular, vocês where it is plural (L word by word; B and R sentence by sentence)
decisions.reason: For the whole book. Moses speaks to Israel now in the plural and now in the singular, as one people (m2 on verse 9). Literal follows the Hebrew number word by word. Balanced and Readable follow it sentence by sentence, so that no Portuguese sentence mixes "tu" and "vocês": here "ouve" (singular) has a sentence of its own and "vocês viverão" the next. Where one Hebrew sentence changes number they split it where the change falls (verses 3, 21, 23) or keep the number of most of the sentence (verses 25, 29, 34), as Leviticus 19:2 does. The Readable keeps the singular where the English Readable says "yourselves" (verse 9).

decisions.choice: os estatutos e as ordenanças (L, B); as leis e as regras (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the pair for the whole body of the law (m2) is "os estatutos e as ordenanças" at Literal and Balanced (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md: statute, rule) and "as leis e as regras" at Readable, as the English Readable says "laws and rules". Leviticus 18:4 has "juízos" at Literal; Deuteronomy keeps one word at both Literal and Balanced. "Os antepassados" (B, R) rather than "os pais", which in Portuguese means one's own father and mother.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic
alternatives: Mark pronouns for God with a setting span, as the English does
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for God are written as for anyone else.

decisions.choice: Singular and plural address follow the Hebrew: "እስራኤል ሆይ ... ስማ" (singular), "የማስተምራችሁን" (plural)
decisions.reason: Moses speaks to Israel now as one person (አንተ) and now as many (እናንተ), sometimes in one verse (verses 3, 23, 29), and Amharic can follow each turn, so it does. The words for the law are "ሥርዓቶች" (statutes) and "ፍርዶች" (L), "ደንቦች" (B), "ሕጎች" (R) (judgments), as in Leviticus; "ትወርሱ" (take possession) is the verb of the land throughout.

decisions.choice: "विधियाँ और नियम" for "statutes and judgments"
decisions.reason: The pair stands for the whole body of God's law (m1). Hindi keeps the two words the Pentateuch uses for them, "विधि" (statute) and "नियम" (rule), at every level, so that the pair is heard as the same formula wherever it comes in Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: "установления и правила" (L, B); "законы и правила" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Deuteronomy, as the Pentateuch note settles: huqqim "установления", mishpatim "правила", mitsvot "заповеди". Together they mean the whole body of God's law (m2); Readable says "законы и правила". ¦

decisions.choice: chuqqim and mishpatim "定めと掟" (L, B), "きまりとおきて" (R), as DEU 5 onward.
decisions.reason: One pair for the whole book.

decisions.choice: "постанови й правила" (L, B); "закони й правила" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Old Testament terms note (statute "постанова", rule "правило"); Readable uses the everyday "закони", as the English Readable says "laws and rules". The pair holds through the book.

decisions.choice: "ketetapan" (statutes) and "peraturan" (rulings) at Literal and Balanced; "hukum dan peraturan" at Readable; "perintah" for commandments
decisions.reason: The glossary's words for the pair that runs through Deuteronomy (huqqim, mishpatim), kept apart from "perintah" (mitsvot). Readable says "laws and rules", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "律例和典章" (L); "律例和规定" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy's pair for the whole body of God's law (m2), in the glossary's words and as Leviticus 18:4-5 has them in Chinese: statute 律例 at every level, rule 典章 at Literal and 规定 at Balanced and Readable. Set here for the book.

decisions.choice: "{{god_term:神|上帝}}": "神" by default, "上帝" as the reader's alternative
decisions.reason: Every word naming the one God is written with the Chinese god_term setting in this chapter, as in chapters 1-3; the English has no such setting.

decisions.choice: "At ngayon"
decisions.reason: The turn from what happened to what Israel must do (m1).

decisions.choice: "mga tuntunin at mga batas"
decisions.reason: The whole body of God's law (m2); glossary triad *utos*, *tuntunin*, *batas*.

decisions.choice: "upang kayo ay mabuhay"; "Sa gayon ay mabubuhay kayo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Life in the land comes with obedience (m3), as English (en2). Literal: "makinig ka" singular, the rest plural, as the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "mga ama" (L); "mga ninuno" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As English (en1).

decisions.choice: "ਬਿਧੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਆਂ" for statutes and judgments (Literal, Balanced); Readable "ਨਿਯਮ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਨੂੰਨ"
decisions.reason: Huqqim are fixed decrees and mishpatim are rulings; together they name the whole law, as in 2 Kings 17:37.

source.text: לֹ֣א תֹסִ֗פוּ עַל־הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תִגְרְע֖וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ לִשְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת־מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Not you shall add to the word that I [am] commanding you, and not you shall take away from it, to keep [the] commandments of Yahweh your God that I [am] commanding you.

en.L: You shall not add to the word that I [am] commanding you, and you shall not take away from it, so as to keep the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God that I [am] commanding you.
en.B: Add nothing to the word I am commanding you, and take nothing away from it, so that you keep the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God that I am giving you.
en.R: Do not add anything to what I command you, and do not take anything away from it. Just obey the commands of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God that I am giving you.

es.L: No {{plural_you:añadirán|añadiréis}} a la palabra que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} mando, y no {{plural_you:quitarán|quitaréis}} de ella, para guardar los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} mando.
es.B: No {{plural_you:añadan|añadáis}} nada a la palabra que {{plural_you:les|os}} mando, ni {{plural_you:quiten|quitéis}} nada de ella; así {{plural_you:guardarán|guardaréis}} los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} doy.
es.R: No {{plural_you:agreguen|agreguéis}} nada a lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} mando, ni {{plural_you:quiten|quitéis}} nada. Solo {{plural_you:obedezcan|obedeced}} los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} que {{plural_you:les|os}} estoy dando.

fr.L: Vous n’ajouterez pas à la parole que je vous commande, et vous n’en retrancherez pas, pour garder les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu que je vous commande.
fr.B: N’ajoutez rien à la parole que je vous prescris et n’en retirez rien : ainsi vous garderez les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu que je vous transmets.
fr.R: N’ajoutez rien à ce que je vous commande, et n’en enlevez rien. Obéissez simplement aux commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu, que je vous donne.

sw.L: Msiongeze katika neno ninalowaamuru, wala msipunguze kutoka kwalo, ili mzishike amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ninazowaamuru.
sw.B: Msiongeze chochote katika neno ninalowaamuru, wala msipunguze chochote, ili mpate kushika amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ninazowapa.
sw.R: Msiongeze kitu katika yale ninayowaamuru, wala msiondoe kitu. Shikeni tu amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ninazowapa.

ko.L: 내가 너희에게 명령하는 말에 너희는 더하지 말고 그것에서 빼지도 말라. 그리하여 내가 너희에게 명령하는 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 계명을 지켜라.
ko.B: 내가 너희에게 명령하는 말에 아무것도 더하지 말고 아무것도 빼지 말라. 그렇게 하여 내가 너희에게 전하는 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 계명을 지켜라.
ko.R: 제가 여러분에게 명령하는 말에 아무것도 더하지 말고, 아무것도 빼지 마십시오. 제가 여러분에게 전하는 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령을 그대로 지키십시오.

vi.L: Các ngươi chớ thêm vào lời mà tôi truyền cho các ngươi, và chớ bớt đi điều gì, để giữ các điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi mà tôi truyền cho các ngươi.
vi.B: Đừng thêm gì vào lời tôi truyền cho anh em, cũng đừng bớt đi điều gì, để anh em giữ các điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em mà tôi đang truyền cho anh em.
vi.R: Đừng thêm điều gì vào những gì tôi truyền cho anh em, cũng đừng bớt đi điều gì. Chỉ hãy vâng giữ các điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em mà tôi đang truyền cho anh em.

pt.L: Vocês não acrescentarão [nada] à palavra que eu estou ordenando a vocês, e não tirarão [nada] dela, para guardar os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, que eu estou ordenando a vocês.
pt.B: Vocês não acrescentarão nada à palavra que eu lhes ordeno, nem tirarão nada dela; assim guardarão os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, que eu lhes dou.
pt.R: Não acrescentem nada ao que eu ordeno a vocês, e não tirem nada disso. Simplesmente obedeçam aos mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, que eu estou dando a vocês.

am.L: እኔ የማዝዛችሁን የአምላካችሁን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትእዛዛት ትጠብቁ ዘንድ፣ እኔ በማዝዛችሁ ቃል ላይ አትጨምሩ፤ ከእርሱም አታጉድሉ።
am.B: እኔ በማዝዛችሁ ቃል ላይ ምንም አትጨምሩ፤ ከእርሱም ምንም አታጉድሉ፤ ይኸውም እኔ የምሰጣችሁን የአምላካችሁን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትእዛዛት እንድትጠብቁ ነው።
am.R: በማዝዛችሁ ቃል ላይ ምንም አትጨምሩ፤ ከእርሱም ምንም አትቀንሱ። እኔ የምሰጣችሁን የአምላካችሁን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትእዛዛት ብቻ ፈጽሙ።

hi.L: जो वचन मैं तुम्हें आज्ञा के रूप में दे रहा [हूँ], उसमें तुम न कुछ जोड़ना और न उसमें से कुछ घटाना, कि तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की उन आज्ञाओं को मानो जो मैं तुम्हें दे रहा [हूँ]।
hi.B: जो वचन मैं तुम्हें दे रहा हूँ, उसमें न कुछ जोड़ना और न उसमें से कुछ घटाना, कि तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की वे आज्ञाएँ मानो जो मैं तुम्हें दे रहा हूँ।
hi.R: जो आज्ञा मैं तुम्हें देता हूँ, उसमें कुछ मत जोड़ो, और उसमें से कुछ मत निकालो। बस {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की वे आज्ञाएँ मानो जो मैं तुम्हें दे रहा हूँ।

ru.L: Не прибавляйте к слову, которое я повелеваю вам, и не убавляйте от него, чтобы соблюдать заповеди {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, вашего Бога, которые я повелеваю вам.
ru.B: Ничего не прибавляйте к слову, которое я вам повелеваю, и ничего не убавляйте от него, чтобы соблюдать заповеди {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, вашего Бога, которые я вам даю.
ru.R: Ничего не добавляйте к тому, что я вам повелеваю, и ничего не убирайте. Просто исполняйте заповеди {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, вашего Бога, которые я вам даю.

ja.L: わたしがあなたがたに命じる言葉に付け加えてはならない。またそれから取り去ってはならない。わたしがあなたがたに命じる、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の戒めを守るためである。
ja.B: わたしがあなたがたに命じる言葉に何も付け加えてはならない。また何も取り去ってはならない。こうして、わたしが命じるあなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の戒めを守りなさい。
ja.R: わたしが命じることに何かを付け加えてはいけない。また、何かを取り去ってもいけない。わたしが伝える、あなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の命令を、そのまま守りなさい。

uk.L: Не додавайте до слова, яке я наказую вам, і не віднімайте від нього, щоб дотримуватися заповідей {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, вашого Бога, які я наказую вам.
uk.B: Нічого не додавайте до слова, яке я вам наказую, і нічого не віднімайте від нього, щоб дотримуватися заповідей {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, вашого Бога, які я вам даю.
uk.R: Не додавайте нічого до того, що я вам наказую, і нічого не відкидайте. Просто виконуйте заповіді {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, вашого Бога, які я вам даю.

id.L: Janganlah kalian menambahi firman yang aku perintahkan kepada kalian, dan janganlah kalian mengurangi daripadanya, supaya kalian berpegang pada perintah-perintah {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, yang aku perintahkan kepada kalian.
id.B: Janganlah menambahkan sesuatu pada firman yang aku perintahkan kepada kalian, dan janganlah mengurangi sesuatu daripadanya, supaya kalian berpegang pada perintah-perintah {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, yang aku sampaikan kepada kalian.
id.R: Jangan menambahkan apa pun pada apa yang aku perintahkan kepada kalian, dan jangan mengurangi apa pun daripadanya. Taatilah saja perintah-perintah {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, yang aku sampaikan kepada kalian.

zh.L: 我吩咐你们的话，你们不可往上加，也不可从中减去，好遵守{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}的诫命，就是我所吩咐你们的。
zh.B: 我吩咐你们的话，你们不可增加什么，也不可减少什么，这样你们才能遵守{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}的诫命，就是我交给你们的。
zh.R: 我吩咐你们的话，你们不要加上什么，也不要拿掉什么。你们只要遵守我交给你们的、{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}的命令。

tl.L: Huwag ninyong dadagdagan ang salitang iniuutos ko sa inyo, at huwag ninyong babawasan ito, upang ingatan ang mga utos {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos na iniuutos ko sa inyo.
tl.B: Huwag ninyong dagdagan ang salitang iniuutos ko sa inyo, at huwag ninyong bawasan ito, upang inyong ingatan ang mga utos {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos na ibinibigay ko sa inyo.
tl.R: Huwag ninyong dagdagan ang iniuutos ko sa inyo, at huwag din ninyong bawasan. Sundin lamang ninyo ang mga utos {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos na ibinibigay ko sa inyo.

pa.L: ਜਿਹੜਾ ਬਚਨ ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਹੁਕਮ ਦਿੰਦਾ [ਹਾਂ], ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਾ ਕੁਝ ਵਧਾਉਣਾ ਅਤੇ ਨਾ ਉਸ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕੁਝ ਘਟਾਉਣਾ, ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਤੁਸੀਂ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੇ ਹੁਕਮਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰੋ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦਿੰਦਾ [ਹਾਂ]।
pa.B: ਜਿਹੜਾ ਬਚਨ ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦੇ ਰਿਹਾ ਹਾਂ, ਉਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੁਝ ਨਾ ਜੋੜੋ ਅਤੇ ਨਾ ਉਸ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕੁਝ ਕੱਢੋ, ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਤੁਸੀਂ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੇ ਉਹ ਹੁਕਮ ਮੰਨੋ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਸੁਣਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹਾਂ।
pa.R: ਜੋ ਹੁਕਮ ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹਾਂ, ਉਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਗੱਲ ਜੋੜਨਾ, ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਗੱਲ ਕੱਢਣਾ। ਬਸ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੇ ਉਹ ਹੁਕਮ ਮੰਨਣਾ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦੱਸ ਰਿਹਾ ਹਾਂ।

decisions.choice: the word: all that Moses commands, taken as one whole
decisions.reason: "Word" is singular. It sums up the whole of what Moses is commanding as a single message from God, not one saying among many.

decisions.choice: neither add nor take away: the command stands as God gave it
decisions.reason: No one may improve God's law by adding rules of their own, or soften it by leaving parts out. Deuteronomy repeats the warning at 13:1 (Hebrew numbering), and Proverbs 30:6 and Revelation 22:18-19 echo it.

decisions.choice: to keep: the way to keep the commandments is to leave them unchanged
decisions.reason: The infinitive "to keep" shows the purpose of the two warnings: by neither adding nor removing, Israel keeps God's commandments as they are.

decisions.choice: I am giving you
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "I am commanding you" twice. Balanced and Readable say "giving" the second time to avoid the repetition; Literal keeps both.

decisions.choice: mitsvot "戒め" (L, B), "命令" (R), as DEU 5 onward.
decisions.reason: One word for the whole book.

decisions.choice: "诫命" (L, B); "命令" (R)
decisions.reason: Commandment as the glossary has it at Literal and Balanced; Readable uses the everyday word, as the English Readable says "commands". Laws are 不可 at Literal and Balanced, 不要 at Readable, as the style guide sets out.

decisions.choice: "ang salita"
decisions.reason: All that Moses commands, as one whole (m1).

decisions.choice: "dadagdagan ... babawasan"
decisions.reason: The command stands as God gave it (m2).

decisions.choice: "upang ingatan"; "ibinibigay ko" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Keeping means leaving them unchanged (m3), as English (en1).

source.text: עֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ הָֽרֹאֹ֔ת אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה בְּבַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר כִּ֣י כָל־הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָלַךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י בַֽעַל־פְּע֔וֹר הִשְׁמִיד֛וֹ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Your eyes [are] the [ones] seeing what did Yahweh at Baal-peor; for every man who walked after Baal-peor, destroyed him Yahweh your God from your midst.

en.L: Your eyes [are] the ones that saw what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} did at Baal-peor; for every man who walked after Baal-peor, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God destroyed him from your midst.
en.B: Your own eyes have seen what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} did at Baal-peor: every man who went after the Baal of Peor, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God wiped out from among you.
en.R: You saw for yourselves what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} did at Baal-peor. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God wiped out every man among you who worshiped the god Baal there.

es.L: {{plural_you:Los ojos de ustedes|Vuestros ojos}} [son] los que vieron lo que hizo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en Baal-peor; porque a todo hombre que anduvo tras Baal-peor, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios lo destruyó de en medio de ti.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes han|Vosotros habéis}} visto con {{plural_you:sus propios ojos|vuestros propios ojos}} lo que hizo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en Baal-peor: a todo hombre que siguió al Baal de Peor, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios lo exterminó de en medio de ti.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes vieron|Vosotros visteis}} con {{plural_you:sus propios ojos|vuestros propios ojos}} lo que hizo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en Baal-peor. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios eliminó de en medio de ti a todos los hombres que adoraron allí al dios Baal.

fr.L: Vos yeux [sont] ceux qui ont vu ce qu’a fait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à Baal-Peor ; car tout homme qui a marché derrière Baal-Peor, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu l’a détruit du milieu de toi.
fr.B: Vous avez vu de vos propres yeux ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait à Baal-Peor : tous les hommes qui avaient suivi le Baal de Peor, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu les a exterminés du milieu de toi.
fr.R: Vous avez vu vous-mêmes ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait à Baal-Peor. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu a fait disparaître du milieu de toi tous les hommes qui y avaient adoré le dieu Baal.

sw.L: Macho yenu [ndiyo] yaliyoona aliyoyafanya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Baal-peori; kwa maana kila mwanamume aliyemfuata Baal-peori, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alimwangamiza kutoka katikati yako.
sw.B: Macho yenu wenyewe yameona alichofanya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Baal-peori: kila mwanamume aliyemfuata Baali wa Peori, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alimfutilia mbali kutoka miongoni mwako.
sw.R: Ninyi wenyewe mliona kwa macho yenu alichofanya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Baal-peori. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako aliwaangamiza kutoka miongoni mwako wanaume wote walioabudu mungu Baali huko.

ko.L: 너희 눈이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 바알브올 때문에 하신 일을 보았다. 바알브올을 따라간 모든 사람을 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희 가운데서 멸하셨다.
ko.B: 너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 바알브올에서 하신 일을 너희 눈으로 직접 보았다. 브올의 바알을 따라간 사람은 하나도 빠짐없이 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희 가운데서 없애 버리셨다.
ko.R: 여러분은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 바알브올에서 하신 일을 직접 보았습니다. 그곳에서 바알이라는 신을 섬긴 사람은 모두 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분 가운데서 없애 버리셨습니다.

vi.L: Mắt các ngươi là [mắt] đã thấy điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm tại Ba-anh Phê-o; vì mọi người đã đi theo Ba-anh Phê-o, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã tiêu diệt người ấy khỏi giữa ngươi.
vi.B: Chính mắt anh em đã thấy điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm tại Ba-anh Phê-o: tất cả những người đi theo thần Ba-anh của Phê-o đều bị {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em tiêu diệt khỏi giữa anh em.
vi.R: Anh em đã tận mắt thấy điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm tại Ba-anh Phê-o. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đã tiêu diệt khỏi giữa anh em mọi người đã thờ thần Ba-anh tại đó.

pt.L: Os olhos de vocês [são] os que viram o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez em Baal-Peor; pois todo homem que andou atrás de Baal-Peor, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, o destruiu do teu meio.
pt.B: Vocês viram com os próprios olhos o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez em Baal-Peor. Todo homem que seguiu o Baal de Peor, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, eliminou do teu meio.
pt.R: Vocês mesmos viram o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez em Baal-Peor. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, acabou com todos os homens do teu povo que adoraram ali o deus Baal.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በብዔልፌጎር ያደረገውን ያዩ ዓይኖቻችሁ ናቸው፤ ብዔልፌጎርን የተከተለውን ሰው ሁሉ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከመካከልህ አጥፍቶታልና።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በብዔልፌጎር ያደረገውን በገዛ ዓይኖቻችሁ አይታችኋል፤ የፌጎርን በኣል የተከተለውን ሰው ሁሉ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከመካከልህ አጠፋው።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በብዔልፌጎር ያደረገውን በዓይናችሁ አይታችኋል። በዚያ በኣል የተባለውን አምላክ ያመለከውን ሰው ሁሉ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከመካከልህ አጠፋው።

hi.L: तुम्हारी आँखों ने वह देखा है जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने बाल-पोर [के कारण] किया; क्योंकि जितने पुरुष बाल-पोर के पीछे चले, उन सब को {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने तुम्हारे बीच में से नष्ट कर दिया।
hi.B: तुमने अपनी आँखों से देखा है कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने बाल-पोर के मामले में क्या किया: जितने पुरुष पोर के बाल देवता के पीछे चले, उन सब को {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने तुम्हारे बीच में से मिटा डाला।
hi.R: तुमने स्वयं देखा कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने बाल-पोर में क्या किया। तुममें से जितने पुरुषों ने वहाँ बाल देवता की पूजा की, उन सब को {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने मिटा डाला।

ru.L: Ваши глаза видели, что сделал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} из-за Ваал-Фегора: каждого человека, который пошёл за Ваал-Фегором, истребил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, из твоей среды.
ru.B: Вы своими глазами видели, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сделал из-за Ваал-Фегора: каждого, кто пошёл за Ваал-Фегором, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог, истребил из вашей среды.
ru.R: Вы сами видели, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сделал в Ваал-Фегоре. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог, истребил среди вас каждого, кто поклонялся там богу Ваалу.

ja.L: あなたがたの目は、バアル・ペオルで{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がなさったことを見た。ペオルのバアルに従って歩んだ者はみな、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたがたの中から滅ぼされたからである。
ja.B: あなたがたは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がバアル・ペオルでなさったことを、自分の目で見た。ペオルのバアルに従った者を、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はみな、あなたがたの中から滅ぼし去られた。
ja.R: あなたたちは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がバアル・ペオルでなさったことを、自分の目で見た。そこでペオルの神バアルを拝んだ者を、あなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、一人残らず滅ぼされた。

uk.L: Ваші очі [ті], що бачили, що зробив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} у Баал-Пеорі; бо кожного чоловіка, який ходив за Баал-Пеором, знищив його {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, з-посеред тебе.
uk.B: Ви на власні очі бачили, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} зробив у Баал-Пеорі: кожного чоловіка, який пішов за Ваалом Пеорським, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, вигубив з-посеред тебе.
uk.R: Ви самі бачили, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} зробив у Баал-Пеорі. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, знищив з-посеред тебе кожного чоловіка, який поклонявся там богові Ваалу.

id.L: Mata kalian sendiri telah melihat apa yang dilakukan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} di Baal-Peor; sebab setiap orang yang mengikuti Baal-Peor telah dibinasakan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, dari tengah-tengahmu.
id.B: Mata kalian sendiri telah melihat apa yang dilakukan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} di Baal-Peor: setiap orang yang mengikuti Baal di Peor dibinasakan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, dari tengah-tengahmu.
id.R: Kalian sudah melihat sendiri apa yang dilakukan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}} di Baal-Peor. {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, membinasakan setiap orang di antara kalian yang menyembah dewa Baal di sana.

zh.L: 你们的眼睛看见了{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}在巴力毗珥所做的；因为凡是跟着巴力毗珥走的人，{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}都已把他从你中间毁灭了。
zh.B: 你们亲眼看见了{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}在巴力毗珥所做的事：凡是去跟从毗珥的巴力的人，{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}都把他们从你们中间消灭了。
zh.R: 你们亲眼看见了{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}在巴力毗珥所做的事。你们中间所有在那里拜巴力这个神明的男人，{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}都把他们消灭了。

tl.L: Ang inyong mga mata ang nakakita sa ginawa {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} sa Baal-peor; sapagkat ang bawat lalaking sumunod kay Baal-peor ay nilipol {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} iyong Diyos mula sa gitna mo.
tl.B: Nakita mismo ng inyong mga mata ang ginawa {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} sa Baal-peor: ang bawat lalaking sumunod sa Baal ng Peor ay nilipol {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos mula sa gitna ninyo.
tl.R: Nakita ninyo mismo ang ginawa {{divine_name:ng PANGINOON|ni Yahweh}} sa Baal-peor. Nilipol {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos ang bawat lalaki sa inyo na sumamba sa diyos na si Baal doon.

pa.L: ਤੁਹਾਡੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਨੇ ਹੀ ਵੇਖਿਆ ਜੋ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਬਆਲ-ਪਓਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੀਤਾ; ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਹਰ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਜਿਹੜਾ ਬਆਲ-ਪਓਰ ਦੇ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਚੱਲਿਆ, {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰੋਂ ਨਾਸ ਕਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ।
pa.B: ਤੂੰ ਆਪਣੀ ਅੱਖੀਂ ਵੇਖਿਆ ਹੈ ਕਿ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਬਆਲ-ਪਓਰ ਵਿਖੇ ਕੀ ਕੀਤਾ: ਹਰ ਆਦਮੀ ਜਿਹੜਾ ਪਓਰ ਦੇ ਬਆਲ ਦੇ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਲੱਗਿਆ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਨੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਮਿਟਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ।
pa.R: ਤੂੰ ਆਪ ਵੇਖਿਆ ਕਿ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਨੇ ਬਆਲ-ਪਓਰ ਵਿਖੇ ਕੀ ਕੀਤਾ। ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਜਿਸ ਕਿਸੇ ਆਦਮੀ ਨੇ ਉੱਥੇ ਬਆਲ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਦੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਕੀਤੀ, {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਨਾਸ ਕਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ।

decisions.choice: Baal-peor: Israel's worship of the god of Peor in Moab
decisions.reason: Numbers 25:1-9 tells how men of Israel joined the Moabites in worshiping Baal of Peor, and how those who did died in a plague. The people Moses now speaks to saw it happen only a short time before.

decisions.choice: walked after: followed as a god, gave loyalty and worship
decisions.reason: To walk after a god is to follow and serve it (6:14; 8:19). The picture is of a servant walking behind a master.

decisions.choice: Baal-peor: the name both of the place and of the god worshiped there
decisions.reason: "At Baal-peor" names the place; "after Baal-peor" names the god, "Baal" (lord, master) of Peor. The same name serves for both.

decisions.choice: every man: the men who joined in that worship
decisions.reason: The word can mean "each person", but Numbers 25 tells of men who joined themselves to Baal of Peor through Moabite women, and "every man" fits that account.

decisions.choice: who worshiped the god Baal there
decisions.reason: Readable explains "walked after Baal-peor" and says that Baal was a god.

decisions.choice: plural "{{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}" for "your eyes", then singular "tu Dios", "de en medio de ti"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew shifts from plural to singular inside the verse, and Spanish follows its number at every level, as set at 1:8.

decisions.choice: "바알브올" for the place and the god (Balanced "브올의 바알" for the god)
decisions.reason: As the Korean Numbers 25 spells it; Balanced names the god separately where the English Balanced does, so the two senses of the name stay clear.

decisions.choice: "Ba-anh Phê-o" (L); "Ba-anh Phê-o" for the place and "thần Ba-anh của Phê-o" (B), "thần Ba-anh" (R) for the god
decisions.reason: The name is both the place and the god worshiped there (meaning decision); "Ba-anh" and "Phê-o" are the forms of Psalm 106:28 and Joshua 22:17. Balanced and Readable say "thần" where the god is meant.

decisions.choice: Baal-Peor; o Baal de Peor (B, the god)
decisions.reason: "Baal-Peor" is the form of Numbers 25:3 in Portuguese. Balanced says "o Baal de Peor" where the name stands for the god (m3), as the English Balanced does. "Andou atrás de" (L) keeps the Hebrew picture of walking after a master (m2); Balanced says "seguiu".

decisions.choice: "ብዔልፌጎር" (Baal-peor), the place and the god; "የፌጎር በኣል" (B), "በኣል" (R) for the god
decisions.reason: The name is both the place and the god worshiped there (m3); Balanced and Readable name the god as the English does.

decisions.choice: "バアル・ペオル" for the place; the god "ペオルのバアル" (L, B) and "ペオルの神バアル" (R), as Numbers 25.
decisions.reason: m3: the name is both the place and the god.

decisions.choice: "Баал-Пеор" for the place; "Ваал" for the god
decisions.reason: As the Old Testament terms note, the god is "Ваал". The place name keeps the transcription "Баал-Пеор", as "Бет-Пеор" in 3:29, so place and god stay apart where Balanced names both.

decisions.choice: "Baal-Peor"; "dewa Baal" (R)
decisions.reason: "Baal" is the glossary form; the place takes the god's name, as in Numbers 25. Readable says "the god Baal", as the English Readable does, with "dewa" for a named pagan god.

decisions.choice: "巴力毗珥" (L, and the place at B, R); "毗珥的巴力" (B, the god); "巴力这个神明" (R)
decisions.reason: Baal-peor names both the place and the god (m3); Baal as the glossary and Peor as Numbers 31:16. Balanced names the god as "the Baal of Peor" and Readable says he was a god, as the English levels do.

decisions.choice: "Baal-peor"
decisions.reason: Israel's worship of the god of Peor; the name of place and god (m1, m3).

decisions.choice: "sumunod kay" (L); "sumamba" (R)
decisions.reason: Followed as a god (m2), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "ang bawat lalaki"
decisions.reason: The men who joined in that worship (m4).

source.text: וְאַתֶּם֙ הַדְּבֵקִ֔ים בַּיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם חַיִּ֥ים כֻּלְּכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: But you, the [ones] holding fast to Yahweh your God, [are] alive all of you this day.

en.L: But you who held fast to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God [are] alive, all of you, this day.
en.B: But you who clung to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God are alive today, every one of you.
en.R: But all of you who stayed loyal to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God are still alive today.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que {{plural_you:se aferraron|os aferrasteis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, [{{plural_you:están|estáis}}] vivos, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, este día.
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, que {{plural_you:se mantuvieron|os mantuvisteis}} unidos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, {{plural_you:están|estáis}} hoy vivos, todos y cada uno.
es.R: Pero todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que {{plural_you:permanecieron|permanecisteis}} fieles {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} vivos hoy.

fr.L: Mais vous qui vous êtes attachés {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu, [vous êtes] vivants, vous tous, ce jour.
fr.B: Mais vous qui êtes restés attachés {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu, vous êtes tous vivants aujourd’hui.
fr.R: Mais vous tous qui êtes restés fidèles {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu, vous êtes encore en vie aujourd’hui.

sw.L: Lakini ninyi mlioshikamana na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, [mko] hai, ninyi nyote, siku hii.
sw.B: Lakini ninyi mlioambatana na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu mko hai leo, kila mmoja wenu.
sw.R: Lakini ninyi nyote mliobaki waaminifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu bado mko hai leo.

ko.L: 그러나 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 붙어 있던 너희는 오늘 모두 살아 있다.
ko.B: 그러나 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 꼭 붙어 있던 너희는 오늘 한 사람도 빠짐없이 살아 있다.
ko.R: 그러나 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 끝까지 충성한 여러분은 모두 오늘 살아 있습니다.

vi.L: Còn các ngươi, là những người đã gắn bó với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, hôm nay hết thảy các ngươi đều còn sống.
vi.B: Còn anh em, những người đã gắn bó với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của mình, thì hôm nay tất cả đều còn sống.
vi.R: Nhưng tất cả anh em, là những người đã trung thành với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, hôm nay vẫn còn sống.

pt.L: Mas vocês, os que se apegaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, [estão] vivos, todos vocês, hoje.
pt.B: Mas vocês, que se apegaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, estão vivos hoje, todos vocês.
pt.R: Mas todos vocês que continuaram fiéis {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, ainda estão vivos hoje.

am.L: እናንተ ግን ከአምላካችሁ {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ጋር የተጣበቃችሁ ሁላችሁ ዛሬ በሕይወት [አላችሁ]።
am.B: ከአምላካችሁ {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ጋር የተጣበቃችሁ እናንተ ግን ሁላችሁም ዛሬ በሕይወት አላችሁ።
am.R: ለአምላካችሁ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ታማኞች ሆናችሁ የቆያችሁ ሁላችሁ ግን ዛሬም በሕይወት አላችሁ።

hi.L: पर तुम जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर से लिपटे रहे, आज के दिन तुम सब जीवित [हो]।
hi.B: पर तुम जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर से लिपटे रहे, आज तुममें से हर एक जीवित है।
hi.R: पर तुम सब जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के प्रति वफ़ादार रहे, आज भी जीवित हो।

ru.L: А вы, прилепившиеся к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вашему Богу, живы все вы сегодня.
ru.B: А вы, кто остался верен {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вашему Богу, сегодня все живы.
ru.R: А все вы, кто остался верным {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вашему Богу, до сих пор живы.

ja.L: しかし、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に固く結びついていたあなたがたは、今日、皆生きている。
ja.B: しかし、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にすがりついていたあなたがたは、今日、一人残らず生きている。
ja.R: しかし、あなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に忠実であり続けたあなたたちは、みな今日も生きている。

uk.L: А ви, що трималися {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, вашого Бога, живі всі ви цього дня.
uk.B: А ви, що залишилися вірні {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, вашому Богові, сьогодні живі, всі до одного.
uk.R: Але всі ви, хто залишився вірним {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, вашому Богові, досі живі.

id.L: Tetapi kalian yang berpaut kepada {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, masih hidup, kalian semua, pada hari ini.
id.B: Tetapi kalian yang tetap berpaut kepada {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, masih hidup hari ini, setiap orang dari kalian.
id.R: Tetapi kalian semua yang tetap setia kepada {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, masih hidup sampai hari ini.

zh.L: 但你们这些紧靠{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}的人，今天全都活着。
zh.B: 但是你们这些紧紧依附{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}的人，今天每一个都还活着。
zh.R: 但是你们所有对{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}保持忠心的人，今天都还活着。

tl.L: Ngunit kayong nanatiling nakakapit {{divine_name:sa PANGINOONG|kay Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos ay buhay, kayong lahat, sa araw na ito.
tl.B: Ngunit kayong kumapit {{divine_name:sa PANGINOONG|kay Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos ay buhay ngayon, bawat isa sa inyo.
tl.R: Ngunit kayong lahat na nanatiling tapat {{divine_name:sa PANGINOONG|kay Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos ay buhay pa ngayon.

pa.L: ਪਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜਿਹੜੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਨਾਲ ਚਿੰਬੜੇ ਰਹੇ, ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਅੱਜ ਦੇ ਦਿਨ ਜੀਉਂਦੇ [ਹੋ]।
pa.B: ਪਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜਿਹੜੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੇ ਰਹੇ, ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਹਰ ਇੱਕ ਅੱਜ ਜੀਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
pa.R: ਪਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਜਿਹੜੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੇ ਵਫ਼ਾਦਾਰ ਰਹੇ, ਅੱਜ ਵੀ ਜੀਉਂਦੇ ਹੋ।

decisions.choice: holding fast: clinging, staying joined in loyalty
decisions.reason: The word means to stick or cling to something. It is used of a man joined to his wife (Genesis 2:24) and of Israel's loyalty to God (10:20; 13:5 in Hebrew numbering; 30:20).

decisions.choice: alive: the living, set against those who died at Peor
decisions.reason: Those who followed Baal died; those who held to the LORD live. The contrast shows what verse 1 means by "so that you may live".

decisions.choice: stayed loyal
decisions.reason: Readable uses plain words for the picture of clinging to God.

decisions.choice: "nakakapit" (L); "kumapit" (B); "nanatiling tapat" (R)
decisions.reason: Staying joined in loyalty (m1), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "buhay"
decisions.reason: The living, set against those who died at Peor (m2).

source.text: רְאֵ֣ה׀לִמַּ֣דְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֗ם חֻקִּים֙ וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוַּ֖נִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת כֵּ֔ן בְּקֶ֣רֶב הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם בָּאִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: See, I have taught you statutes and judgments, just as commanded me Yahweh my God, to do so in [the] midst of the land where you [are] going there to take possession of it.

en.L: See, I have taught you statutes and judgments just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God commanded me, to do so in the midst of the land that you [are] going into to take possession of it.
en.B: See, I have taught you statutes and rulings, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God commanded me, for you to live by in the land you are going into to take possession of.
en.R: Listen: I have taught you laws and rules, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God told me to. You are to obey them in the land you are about to enter and take possession of.

es.L: Mira, {{plural_you:les|os}} he enseñado estatutos y juicios, tal como me mandó {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mi Dios, para que [los] {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} así en medio de la tierra adonde {{plural_you:ustedes van|vosotros vais}} para tomar posesión de ella.
es.B: Mira, {{plural_you:les|os}} he enseñado estatutos y normas, como me mandó {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mi Dios, para que {{plural_you:vivan|viváis}} conforme a ellos en la tierra donde {{plural_you:van|vais}} a entrar para tomar posesión de ella.
es.R: Escucha: {{plural_you:les|os}} he enseñado leyes y normas, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mi Dios me mandó. {{plural_you:Deberán|Deberéis}} obedecerlas en la tierra donde {{plural_you:están|estáis}} a punto de entrar para tomar posesión de ella.

fr.L: Vois, je vous ai enseigné des prescriptions et des jugements, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu me l’a commandé, pour [les] pratiquer ainsi au milieu du pays où vous entrez pour en prendre possession.
fr.B: Regarde : je vous ai enseigné des prescriptions et des règles, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu me l’a ordonné, pour que vous les suiviez dans le pays où vous allez entrer pour en prendre possession.
fr.R: Écoute : je vous ai enseigné des lois et des règles, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu me l’a demandé. Vous devrez leur obéir dans le pays où vous allez bientôt entrer pour en prendre possession.

sw.L: Tazama, nimewafundisha kanuni na hukumu, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu alivyoniamuru, ili mzitende hivyo katikati ya nchi mnayoiendea ili kuimiliki.
sw.B: Tazama, nimewafundisha kanuni na maagizo, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu alivyoniamuru, ili myafuate katika nchi mnayoingia kuimiliki.
sw.R: Sikiliza: nimewafundisha sheria na maagizo, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu aliniambia. Mtapaswa kuyatii katika nchi mtakayoingia hivi karibuni ili kuimiliki.

ko.L: 보아라, 내가 내 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 명령하신 대로 너희에게 규례와 법도를 가르쳐, 너희가 들어가 차지하려는 땅 가운데서 그렇게 행하게 했다.
ko.B: 보아라, 나는 내 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 명령하신 대로 너희에게 규례와 법도를 가르쳤다. 이것은 너희가 들어가 차지할 땅에서 너희가 지키며 살게 하려는 것이다.
ko.R: 잘 들으십시오. 저는 저의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 저에게 명령하신 대로 여러분에게 법과 규칙을 가르쳤습니다. 여러분은 곧 들어가서 차지할 그 땅에서 그것을 지켜야 합니다.

vi.L: Hãy xem, tôi đã dạy các ngươi các luật lệ và các mạng lệnh như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của tôi đã truyền cho tôi, để các ngươi làm theo như vậy ở giữa xứ mà các ngươi sắp vào để chiếm hữu nó.
vi.B: Này, tôi đã dạy anh em các luật lệ và mạng lệnh như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của tôi đã truyền cho tôi, để anh em sống theo trong xứ mà anh em sắp vào chiếm hữu.
vi.R: Hãy nghe đây: tôi đã dạy anh em những luật lệ và quy tắc, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của tôi đã bảo tôi. Anh em phải vâng giữ chúng trong xứ mà anh em sắp vào và chiếm lấy.

pt.L: Vejam, eu ensinei a vocês estatutos e ordenanças, assim como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o meu Deus, me ordenou, para que façam assim no meio da terra em que vocês [estão] entrando para tomar posse dela.
pt.B: Vejam: eu lhes ensinei estatutos e ordenanças, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o meu Deus, me ordenou, para que vocês vivam segundo eles na terra em que estão entrando para tomar posse dela.
pt.R: Prestem atenção: eu ensinei a vocês leis e regras, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o meu Deus, me mandou. Vocês devem obedecer a elas na terra em que estão para entrar e da qual vão tomar posse.

am.L: እነሆ፣ ልትወርሷት በምትገቡባት ምድር መካከል እንዲሁ ታደርጉ ዘንድ፣ አምላኬ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዳዘዘኝ ሥርዓቶችንና ፍርዶችን አስተምሬአችኋለሁ።
am.B: ተመልከት፤ ልትወርሷት በምትገቡባት ምድር እንድትኖሩባቸው፣ አምላኬ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዳዘዘኝ ሥርዓቶችንና ደንቦችን አስተምሬአችኋለሁ።
am.R: አድምጥ፤ አምላኬ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዳዘዘኝ ሥርዓቶችንና ሕጎችን አስተምሬአችኋለሁ። ገብታችሁ የራሳችሁ በምታደርጓት ምድር ልትፈጽሟቸው ይገባል።

hi.L: देखो, मैंने तुम्हें विधियाँ और नियम सिखाए हैं, जैसी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरे परमेश्वर ने मुझे आज्ञा दी, कि जिस देश पर अधिकार करने के लिए तुम उसमें जा रहे [हो], उसके बीच तुम ऐसा ही करो।
hi.B: देखो, मैंने तुम्हें विधियाँ और नियम सिखाए हैं, जैसी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरे परमेश्वर ने मुझे आज्ञा दी, कि जिस देश पर अधिकार करने के लिए तुम जा रहे हो, उसमें तुम उनके अनुसार चलो।
hi.R: सुनो: मैंने तुम्हें विधियाँ और नियम सिखाए हैं, जैसा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरे परमेश्वर ने मुझसे कहा था। जिस देश में तुम जाकर उसे अपना बनानेवाले हो, उसमें तुम्हें उनका पालन करना है।

ru.L: Смотри, я научил вас установлениям и правилам, как повелел мне {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, мой Бог, чтобы вы так поступали в земле, в которую вы входите, чтобы овладеть ею.
ru.B: Смотрите, я научил вас установлениям и правилам, как повелел мне {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, мой Бог, чтобы вы жили по ним в земле, в которую идёте, чтобы овладеть ею.
ru.R: Слушайте: я научил вас законам и правилам, как велел мне {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, мой Бог. Вы должны исполнять их в земле, в которую скоро войдёте и которой овладеете.

ja.L: 見なさい、わたしは、わたしの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がわたしに命じられたとおりに、あなたがたに定めと掟を教えた。あなたがたが入って行って所有しようとしている地の中で、そのように行うためである。
ja.B: 見なさい。わたしは、わたしの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が命じられたとおりに、定めと掟をあなたがたに教えた。それは、あなたがたが入って行って所有する地で、それに従って生きるためである。
ja.R: よく聞きなさい。わたしは、わたしの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が言われたとおりに、きまりとおきてをあなたたちに教えた。あなたたちがこれから入って、自分たちのものにする地で、それを守りなさい。

uk.L: Дивись, я навчив вас постанов і правил, як наказав мені {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, мій Бог, щоб так виконувати посеред краю, куди ви йдете, щоб заволодіти ним.
uk.B: Дивись, я навчив вас постанов і правил, як наказав мені {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, мій Бог, щоб ви жили за ними в краю, до якого йдете, щоб заволодіти ним.
uk.R: Слухай: я навчив вас законів і правил, як звелів мені {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, мій Бог. Ви маєте виконувати їх у краю, в який скоро ввійдете й яким заволодієте.

id.L: Lihatlah, aku telah mengajarkan kepada kalian ketetapan dan peraturan, seperti yang diperintahkan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahku, kepadaku, untuk dilakukan demikian di tengah-tengah negeri yang akan kalian masuki untuk mendudukinya.
id.B: Lihat, aku telah mengajarkan kepada kalian ketetapan dan peraturan, seperti yang diperintahkan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahku, kepadaku, supaya kalian hidup menurutnya di negeri yang akan kalian masuki untuk diduduki.
id.R: Dengarkanlah: aku sudah mengajarkan hukum dan peraturan kepada kalian, seperti yang diperintahkan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahku, kepadaku. Kalian harus menaatinya di negeri yang akan kalian masuki dan kalian rebut.

zh.L: 你看，我已经教导你们律例和典章，正如{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}我的{{god_term:神|上帝}}吩咐我的，要你们在那地中照样遵行，就是你们要进去得为业的地。
zh.B: 看，我已经照着{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}我的{{god_term:神|上帝}}的吩咐，把律例和规定教导你们，好让你们在要进去占领的地上照着生活。
zh.R: 你们要听：我已经照着{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}我的{{god_term:神|上帝}}的吩咐，把律例和规定教导你们。你们进入那地、把它据为己有以后，要遵守这些律例和规定。

tl.L: Tingnan mo, tinuruan ko kayo ng mga tuntunin at mga batas gaya ng iniutos sa akin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} aking Diyos, upang gawin ninyo ang gayon sa gitna ng lupaing inyong papasukin upang angkinin ito.
tl.B: Tingnan ninyo, tinuruan ko kayo ng mga tuntunin at mga batas, gaya ng iniutos sa akin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} aking Diyos, upang sundin ninyo sa lupaing inyong papasukin upang angkinin.
tl.R: Makinig kayo: tinuruan ko kayo ng mga batas at mga tuntunin, gaya ng sinabi sa akin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} aking Diyos. Dapat ninyong sundin ang mga ito sa lupaing malapit na ninyong pasukin at angkinin.

pa.L: ਵੇਖ, ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਬਿਧੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਆਂ ਸਿਖਾਏ ਹਨ, ਜਿਵੇਂ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਨੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਹੁਕਮ ਦਿੱਤਾ, ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਸ ਦੇਸ਼ ਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਕਰੋ ਜਿਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਕਬਜ਼ਾ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉੱਥੇ ਜਾ ਰਹੇ [ਹੋ]।
pa.B: ਵੇਖੋ, ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਬਿਧੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਆਂ ਸਿਖਾ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਹਨ, ਜਿਵੇਂ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਨੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਆਗਿਆ ਦਿੱਤੀ, ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਜਿਸ ਦੇਸ਼ ਉੱਤੇ ਕਬਜ਼ਾ ਕਰਨ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜਾ ਰਹੇ ਹੋ, ਉੱਥੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਜੀਵਨ ਬਿਤਾਓ।
pa.R: ਸੁਣੋ: ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਨਿਯਮ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਨੂੰਨ ਸਿਖਾਏ ਹਨ, ਜਿਵੇਂ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਨੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਕਿਹਾ ਸੀ। ਜਿਹੜੇ ਦੇਸ਼ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਵੜਨ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਹੋ, ਉੱਥੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਮੰਨਣਾ ਹੈ।

decisions.choice: See: a call for attention
decisions.reason: "See" here does not ask anyone to look at something. It calls the hearers to take note of what follows.

decisions.choice: as the LORD my God commanded me: Moses teaches only what God gave him
decisions.reason: Moses claims no law of his own. What he teaches comes from God, who commanded him to teach it (verse 14; 1:3).

decisions.choice: in the midst of the land: the law is meant for life in the land
decisions.reason: The statutes are given now, before the crossing, to be done once Israel lives in the land. Much of the law assumes a settled people with towns, fields and courts.

decisions.choice: Listen
decisions.reason: Readable says "Listen" so that young readers do not take "See" as an order to look.

decisions.choice: "Tingnan mo" (L); "Makinig kayo" (R)
decisions.reason: A call for attention (m1), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "gaya ng iniutos sa akin"
decisions.reason: Moses teaches only what God gave him (m2).

decisions.choice: "sa gitna ng lupain"
decisions.reason: The law is meant for life in the land (m3).

source.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֮ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם֒ כִּ֣י הִ֤וא חָכְמַתְכֶם֙ וּבִ֣ינַתְכֶ֔ם לְעֵינֵ֖י הָעַמִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁמְע֗וּן אֵ֚ת כָּל־הַחֻקִּ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְאָמְר֗וּ רַ֚ק עַם־חָכָ֣ם וְנָב֔וֹן הַגּ֥וֹי הַגָּד֖וֹל הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And you shall keep and do [them], for it [is] your wisdom and your understanding in [the] eyes of the peoples who will hear all the statutes these, and they will say, surely a people wise and understanding [is] the nation great this.

en.L: And you shall keep and do [them], for that [is] your wisdom and your understanding in the eyes of the peoples, who will hear all these statutes and say, 'Surely this great nation [is] a wise and understanding people.'
en.B: Keep them and follow them, for that is what will make you wise and understanding in the eyes of the peoples. When they hear about all these statutes, they will say, 'This great nation is truly a wise and understanding people.'
en.R: Obey these laws carefully. That is how the other nations will see how wise and understanding you are. They will hear about all these laws and say, 'What a wise and understanding people this great nation is!'

es.L: Y {{plural_you:guardarán|guardaréis}} y {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} [eso], porque esa [es] {{plural_you:la sabiduría y la inteligencia de ustedes|vuestra sabiduría y vuestra inteligencia}} a los ojos de los pueblos, que oirán todos estos estatutos y dirán: “Ciertamente esta gran nación [es] un pueblo sabio e inteligente.”
es.B: {{plural_you:Guárdenlos y pónganlos|Guardadlos y ponedlos}} en práctica, porque eso es lo que {{plural_you:los hará|os hará}} sabios e inteligentes a los ojos de los pueblos. Cuando oigan hablar de todos estos estatutos, dirán: “De veras esta gran nación es un pueblo sabio e inteligente.”
es.R: {{plural_you:Obedezcan|Obedeced}} estas leyes con cuidado. Así las otras naciones verán lo sabios e inteligentes que {{plural_you:son|sois}}. Oirán hablar de todas estas leyes y dirán: “¡Qué pueblo tan sabio e inteligente es esta gran nación!”

fr.L: Et vous [les] garderez et [les] pratiquerez, car c’est là votre sagesse et votre intelligence aux yeux des peuples, qui entendront toutes ces prescriptions et diront : “Assurément, cette grande nation [est] un peuple sage et intelligent.”
fr.B: Gardez-les et mettez-les en pratique, car c’est ce qui fera votre sagesse et votre intelligence aux yeux des peuples. Quand ils entendront parler de toutes ces prescriptions, ils diront : “Cette grande nation est vraiment un peuple sage et intelligent.”
fr.R: Obéissez soigneusement à ces lois. C’est ainsi que les autres nations verront combien vous êtes sages et intelligents. Elles entendront parler de toutes ces lois et diront : “Quel peuple sage et intelligent que cette grande nation !”

sw.L: Nanyi mtazishika na kuzitenda, kwa maana hiyo [ndiyo] hekima yenu na ufahamu wenu machoni pa mataifa, watakaosikia kanuni hizi zote na kusema, 'Hakika taifa hili kubwa [ni] watu wenye hekima na ufahamu.'
sw.B: Zishikeni na kuzitekeleza, kwa maana hilo ndilo litakalowafanya mwonekane wenye hekima na ufahamu machoni pa mataifa. Watakaposikia habari za kanuni hizi zote, watasema, 'Kweli taifa hili kubwa ni watu wenye hekima na ufahamu.'
sw.R: Zitiini sheria hizi kwa uangalifu. Hivyo ndivyo mataifa mengine yatakavyoona jinsi mlivyo na hekima na ufahamu. Yatasikia habari za sheria hizi zote na kusema, 'Kumbe taifa hili kubwa ni watu wenye hekima na ufahamu mwingi!'

ko.L: 그러니 너희는 [그것을] 지켜 행하라. 그것이 민족들의 눈에 너희의 지혜요 너희의 분별력이다. 그들이 이 모든 규례를 듣고 말할 것이다. '참으로 이 큰 나라는 지혜롭고 분별력 있는 백성이다.'
ko.B: 그러니 너희는 그것을 지켜 행하라. 그렇게 하면 민족들이 너희를 지혜롭고 분별력 있는 백성으로 볼 것이다. 그들이 이 모든 규례에 대해 듣고 말할 것이다. '이 큰 나라는 참으로 지혜롭고 분별력 있는 백성이구나.'
ko.R: 이 법들을 잘 지키십시오. 그러면 다른 민족들이 여러분이 얼마나 지혜롭고 슬기로운지 알게 될 것입니다. 그들은 이 모든 법에 대해 듣고 이렇게 말할 것입니다. '이 큰 나라는 정말 지혜롭고 슬기로운 백성이구나!'

vi.L: Vậy các ngươi phải giữ và làm theo [chúng], vì đó [là] sự khôn ngoan và sự hiểu biết của các ngươi trước mắt các dân, là những dân sẽ nghe về tất cả các luật lệ này và nói: 'Thật, dân tộc lớn này [là] một dân khôn ngoan và hiểu biết.'
vi.B: Hãy giữ và làm theo các luật lệ ấy, vì đó chính là điều làm cho anh em được xem là khôn ngoan và hiểu biết trước mắt các dân. Khi nghe về tất cả các luật lệ này, họ sẽ nói: 'Dân tộc lớn này thật là một dân khôn ngoan và hiểu biết!'
vi.R: Hãy cẩn thận vâng giữ các luật lệ này. Nhờ đó các dân khác sẽ thấy anh em khôn ngoan và hiểu biết biết bao. Họ sẽ nghe về tất cả các luật lệ này và nói: 'Dân tộc lớn này thật là khôn ngoan và hiểu biết!'

pt.L: E vocês [os] guardarão e [os] praticarão, pois isso [é] a sabedoria de vocês e o entendimento de vocês aos olhos dos povos, que ouvirão todos estes estatutos e dirão: 'Certamente um povo sábio e entendido [é] esta grande nação.'
pt.B: Vocês os guardarão e os porão em prática, pois é isso que fará de vocês um povo sábio e entendido aos olhos dos outros povos. Quando ouvirem falar de todos estes estatutos, eles dirão: 'Esta grande nação é de fato um povo sábio e entendido.'
pt.R: Obedeçam a essas leis com cuidado. É assim que as outras nações vão ver como vocês são sábios e entendidos. Elas vão ouvir falar de todas essas leis e dizer: 'Que povo sábio e entendido é esta grande nação!'

am.L: ጠብቋቸውም፤ አድርጓቸውም፤ ይህ እነዚህን ሥርዓቶች ሁሉ በሚሰሙ ሕዝቦች ዓይን ጥበባችሁና ማስተዋላችሁ ነውና፤ እነርሱም “በእርግጥ ይህ ታላቅ ሕዝብ ጥበበኛና አስተዋይ ሕዝብ [ነው]” ይላሉ።
am.B: ጠብቋቸው፤ ፈጽሟቸውም፤ በሕዝቦች ዓይን ጥበበኞችና አስተዋዮች የሚያደርጋችሁ ይህ ነውና። እነዚህን ሥርዓቶች ሁሉ በሰሙ ጊዜ “ይህ ታላቅ ሕዝብ በእውነት ጥበበኛና አስተዋይ ሕዝብ ነው” ይላሉ።
am.R: እነዚህን ሥርዓቶች በጥንቃቄ ፈጽሟቸው። ሌሎቹ ሕዝቦች ምን ያህል ጥበበኞችና አስተዋዮች እንደ ሆናችሁ የሚያዩት በዚህ ነው። ስለ እነዚህ ሥርዓቶች ሁሉ ሰምተው “ይህ ታላቅ ሕዝብ እንዴት ያለ ጥበበኛና አስተዋይ ሕዝብ ነው!” ይላሉ።

hi.L: और तुम [उन्हें] मानना और उन पर चलना, क्योंकि उन जातियों की दृष्टि में यही तुम्हारी बुद्धि और तुम्हारी समझ [है], जो इन सब विधियों को सुनेंगी और कहेंगी, 'निश्चय यह बड़ी जाति बुद्धिमान और समझदार लोग [है]।'
hi.B: उन्हें मानो और उन पर चलो, क्योंकि इसी से जातियों की दृष्टि में तुम बुद्धिमान और समझदार ठहरोगे। जब वे इन सब विधियों के विषय में सुनेंगी, तो कहेंगी, 'यह बड़ी जाति सचमुच बुद्धिमान और समझदार लोग है।'
hi.R: इन विधियों का ध्यान से पालन करो। इसी से दूसरी जातियाँ देखेंगी कि तुम कितने बुद्धिमान और समझदार हो। वे इन सब विधियों के बारे में सुनेंगी और कहेंगी, 'यह बड़ी जाति कितने बुद्धिमान और समझदार लोग हैं!'

ru.L: И соблюдайте и исполняйте [их], потому что это — ваша мудрость и ваш разум в глазах народов, которые услышат обо всех этих установлениях и скажут: “Конечно, народ мудрый и разумный этот великий народ.”
ru.B: Соблюдайте и исполняйте их, потому что в этом ваша мудрость и разумность в глазах народов. Когда они услышат обо всех этих установлениях, они скажут: “Этот великий народ — поистине мудрый и разумный народ.”
ru.R: Старательно исполняйте эти законы. Так другие народы увидят, какие вы мудрые и разумные. Они услышат обо всех этих законах и скажут: “Какой мудрый и разумный народ этот великий народ!”

ja.L: あなたがたはそれを守り、行わなければならない。それは諸国の民の目に、あなたがたの知恵、あなたがたの悟りとなるからである。彼らはこれらすべての定めを聞いて言うであろう。『確かに、この大いなる国民は、知恵があり悟りのある民だ。』
ja.B: これを守り行いなさい。そうすれば、諸国の民の目に、あなたがたは知恵があり悟りのある者と映る。彼らはこれらの定めをすべて聞いて言うだろう。『この大いなる国民は、本当に知恵があり悟りのある民だ。』
ja.R: このきまりを、よく守りなさい。そうすれば、ほかの国々の人々は、あなたたちがどれほど知恵があり、よくわかっているかを知る。彼らはこれらのきまりについて聞いて言うだろう。『この大きな国の民は、なんと知恵があって、物事がよくわかる民だろう！』

uk.L: І дотримуйтеся, і виконуйте [їх], бо це ваша мудрість і ваш розум в очах народів, які почують усі ці постанови і скажуть: “Справді, мудрий і розумний народ [цей] великий народ.”
uk.B: Дотримуйтеся їх і виконуйте, бо саме це зробить вас мудрими й розумними в очах народів. Коли вони почують про всі ці постанови, то скажуть: “Цей великий народ — справді мудрий і розумний.”
uk.R: Уважно виконуйте ці закони. Так інші народи побачать, які ви мудрі й розумні. Вони почують про всі ці закони й скажуть: “Який мудрий і розумний цей великий народ!”

id.L: Dan kalian harus berpegang padanya dan melakukannya, sebab itulah hikmat kalian dan pengertian kalian di mata bangsa-bangsa yang akan mendengar semua ketetapan ini, dan mereka akan berkata, 'Sungguh, bangsa yang besar ini adalah umat yang berhikmat dan berpengertian.'
id.B: Berpeganglah padanya dan lakukanlah, sebab itulah yang akan membuat kalian berhikmat dan berpengertian di mata bangsa-bangsa. Apabila mereka mendengar tentang semua ketetapan ini, mereka akan berkata, 'Bangsa yang besar ini sungguh umat yang berhikmat dan berpengertian.'
id.R: Taatilah hukum-hukum ini dengan sungguh-sungguh. Dengan begitu bangsa-bangsa lain akan melihat betapa bijaksana dan pandainya kalian. Mereka akan mendengar tentang semua hukum ini dan berkata, 'Bangsa yang besar ini sungguh bangsa yang bijaksana dan pandai!'

zh.L: 你们要谨守遵行，因为这就是你们在万民眼中的智慧和悟性；他们听见这一切律例，就要说：‘这个大国确实是有智慧、有悟性的民族！’
zh.B: 你们要谨慎遵行这些律例和规定，因为这会使你们在万民眼中显得有智慧、有见识。他们听到这一切律例的时候，会说：‘这个伟大的国家，人民果然有智慧、有见识！’
zh.R: 你们要小心遵守这些律例。这样，其他的民族就会看出你们多么有智慧、多么明白事理。他们听到这些律例，就会说：‘这个大国的人民多么有智慧，多么明白事理啊！’

tl.L: At ingatan ninyo at gawin [ang mga ito], sapagkat iyon [ang] inyong karunungan at inyong pang-unawa sa paningin ng mga bayan, na makaririnig ng lahat ng tuntuning ito at magsasabi, 'Tunay na ang dakilang bansang ito [ay] isang bayang marunong at may pang-unawa.'
tl.B: Ingatan ninyo at sundin ang mga ito, sapagkat iyon ang magpapakita ng inyong karunungan at pang-unawa sa paningin ng mga bayan. Kapag narinig nila ang lahat ng tuntuning ito, sasabihin nila, 'Tunay na marunong at may pang-unawang bayan ang dakilang bansang ito.'
tl.R: Sundin ninyong mabuti ang mga batas na ito. Sa gayon ay makikita ng ibang mga bansa kung gaano kayo kamarunong at kamaunawain. Mababalitaan nila ang lahat ng batas na ito at sasabihin nila, 'Napakarunong at napakamaunawain ng bayan ng dakilang bansang ito!'

pa.L: ਸੋ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰਨੀ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਨਾ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਕੌਮਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਨਜ਼ਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹੋ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਬੁੱਧ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਸਮਝ [ਹੈ], ਜਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਬਿਧੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਣਨਗੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਆਖਣਗੀਆਂ, 'ਸੱਚ-ਮੁੱਚ ਇਹ ਵੱਡੀ ਕੌਮ ਬੁੱਧਵਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਝਦਾਰ ਲੋਕ [ਹੈ]।'
pa.B: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਂਭ ਕੇ ਰੱਖੋ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਚੱਲੋ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਇਸੇ ਨਾਲ ਕੌਮਾਂ ਦੀ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਬੁੱਧ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਝ ਪਰਗਟ ਹੋਵੇਗੀ। ਜਦ ਉਹ ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਬਿਧੀਆਂ ਬਾਰੇ ਸੁਣਨਗੀਆਂ, ਤਾਂ ਆਖਣਗੀਆਂ, 'ਇਹ ਮਹਾਨ ਕੌਮ ਸੱਚ-ਮੁੱਚ ਬੁੱਧਵਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਝਦਾਰ ਲੋਕ ਹਨ।'
pa.R: ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਿਯਮਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਲ ਮੰਨੋ। ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੂਜੀਆਂ ਕੌਮਾਂ ਵੇਖਣਗੀਆਂ ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਅਤੇ ਸੂਝਵਾਨ ਹੋ। ਉਹ ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਨਿਯਮਾਂ ਬਾਰੇ ਸੁਣ ਕੇ ਕਹਿਣਗੀਆਂ, 'ਇਹ ਮਹਾਨ ਕੌਮ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਅਤੇ ਸੂਝਵਾਨ ਲੋਕ ਹਨ!'

decisions.choice: it: the keeping and doing of the statutes
decisions.reason: "It" points back to what Israel does: keeping and doing the law is what makes them wise in others' sight, not merely having it.

decisions.choice: wisdom and understanding: skill in living and insight into what is right
decisions.reason: In the Old Testament wisdom is practical: knowing how to live well before God and others (Proverbs 1:2-7). Understanding is the ability to see into things and judge rightly.

decisions.choice: surely: an exclamation of surprise and admiration
decisions.reason: The small word often means "only", but at the head of a saying like this it stresses what follows: "truly", "indeed".

decisions.choice: What a wise and understanding people this great nation is!
decisions.reason: Readable turns the nations' words into an exclamation, which carries the force of "surely" in plain English.

decisions.choice: "kushika na kutenda" (L); "kushika na kutekeleza" (B); "kutii kwa uangalifu" (R)
decisions.reason: For Deuteronomy's recurring "keep and do" (shamar and asah, 4:6; 5:1, 32; 6:3): "kushika" is to keep or observe a command, and "kutenda" / "kutekeleza" to carry it out. Readable follows the English "obey carefully".

decisions.choice: Keep and do: "谨守遵行" (L); "谨慎遵行" (B); "小心遵守" (R)
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy's paired verbs for obeying the law ("keep ... to do"), set here for the book: Literal keeps both verbs as Leviticus 18:4 has them (谨守, 遵行), Balanced says "谨慎遵行" ("take care to do"), and Readable joins them in "小心遵守", as the English Readable says "obey carefully". One form per level wherever the pair returns.

decisions.choice: "智慧和悟性" (L); "有智慧、有见识" (B); "有智慧、明白事理" (R)
decisions.reason: Wisdom and understanding (m2): 悟性 at Literal as the glossary has binah, with plainer words at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "iyon"
decisions.reason: The keeping and doing of the statutes (m1).

decisions.choice: "karunungan at pang-unawa"
decisions.reason: Skill in living and insight (m2).

decisions.choice: "Tunay na" (L, B); exclamation (R)
decisions.reason: Surprise and admiration (m3), as English (en1).

source.text: כִּ֚י מִי־ג֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר־ל֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים קְרֹבִ֣ים אֵלָ֑יו כַּיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ בְּכָּל־קָרְאֵ֖נוּאֵלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: For who [is] a nation great that has to it gods near to it like Yahweh our God in all our calling to him?

en.L: For what great nation [is there] that has gods [so] near to it as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God [is] whenever we call to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?
en.B: For what great nation has gods as near to it as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God is to us whenever we call to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?
en.R: No other nation, however great, has gods as near to it as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God is to us. He is near whenever we call out to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Porque ¿qué nación grande [hay] que tenga dioses [tan] cercanos a ella como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios [lo está] cada vez que clamamos a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}?
es.B: Pues ¿qué nación grande tiene dioses tan cerca de ella como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios está de nosotros siempre que clamamos a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}?
es.R: Ninguna otra nación, por grande que sea, tiene dioses tan cerca de ella como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios está de nosotros. Él está cerca cada vez que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llamamos.

fr.L: Car quelle [est la] grande nation qui ait des dieux [aussi] proches d’elle que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu [l’est] chaque fois que nous crions vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ?
fr.B: Quelle grande nation, en effet, a des dieux aussi proches d’elle que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu l’est de nous chaque fois que nous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}invoquons ?
fr.R: Aucune autre nation, si grande soit-elle, n’a des dieux aussi proches d’elle que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu l’est de nous. Il est près de nous chaque fois que nous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appelons.

sw.L: Kwa maana ni taifa gani kubwa lililo na miungu iliyo karibu nalo kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu [alivyo] kila tunapomwita?
sw.B: Kwa maana ni taifa gani kubwa lenye miungu iliyo karibu nalo kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu alivyo karibu nasi kila tunapomlilia?
sw.R: Hakuna taifa jingine, hata likiwa kubwa namna gani, lenye miungu iliyo karibu nalo kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu alivyo karibu nasi. Yuko karibu kila tunapomwita.

ko.L: 우리가 그분께 부르짖을 때마다 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}처럼 그렇게 가까이하는 신들을 가진 큰 나라가 어디 있느냐?
ko.B: 우리가 부를 때마다 가까이 계시는 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}처럼, 자기 신들이 그렇게 가까이 있는 큰 나라가 어디 있느냐?
ko.R: 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 우리가 부를 때마다 우리 가까이에 계십니다. 아무리 큰 나라라도 그렇게 가까이 있는 신들을 가진 나라는 없습니다.

vi.L: Vì có dân tộc lớn nào có các thần ở gần mình như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta [ở gần chúng ta] mỗi khi chúng ta kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.B: Vì có dân tộc lớn nào có các thần ở gần mình như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta ở gần chúng ta mỗi khi chúng ta kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.R: Không có dân tộc nào khác, dù lớn đến đâu, có các thần ở gần mình như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta ở gần chúng ta. Ngài ở gần mỗi khi chúng ta kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

pt.L: Pois que grande nação [há] que tenha deuses [tão] próximos de si como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, [está de nós] sempre que clamamos a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}?
pt.B: Pois que grande nação tem deuses tão próximos de si como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, está de nós sempre que clamamos a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}?
pt.R: Nenhuma outra nação, por maior que seja, tem deuses tão perto dela como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, está perto de nós. Ele está perto sempre que clamamos a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.

am.L: በጠራነው ጊዜ ሁሉ አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለእኛ ቅርብ እንደ ሆነ፣ አማልክቱ ለእርሱ ቅርብ የሆኑለት ታላቅ ሕዝብ ማን [ነው]?
am.B: በጠራነው ጊዜ ሁሉ አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለእኛ ቅርብ እንደ ሆነ፣ አማልክቱ ይህን ያህል የሚቀርቡት ታላቅ ሕዝብ ማን ነው?
am.R: አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለእኛ ቅርብ እንደ ሆነ፣ አማልክቱ ለእርሱ ቅርብ የሆኑለት ሌላ ሕዝብ የለም፤ ምንም ያህል ታላቅ ቢሆን። በጠራነው ጊዜ ሁሉ እርሱ ቅርባችን ነው።

hi.L: क्योंकि कौन-सी बड़ी जाति [है] जिसके देवता उसके इतने निकट हों जितने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारा परमेश्वर [हैं], जब-जब हम उन्हें पुकारते हैं?
hi.B: क्योंकि ऐसी कौन-सी बड़ी जाति है जिसके देवता उसके इतने निकट हों जितने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारा परमेश्वर हमारे निकट हैं, जब-जब हम उन्हें पुकारते हैं?
hi.R: कोई दूसरी जाति, चाहे कितनी भी बड़ी हो, ऐसी नहीं जिसके देवता उसके इतने पास हों जितने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारा परमेश्वर हमारे पास हैं। जब भी हम उन्हें पुकारते हैं, वे पास होते हैं।

ru.L: Ведь какой есть великий народ, у которого боги [так] близки к нему, как {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, наш Бог, всякий раз, когда мы взываем к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}}?
ru.B: Ведь какой великий народ имеет богов, которые были бы так близки к нему, как {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, наш Бог, близок к нам, когда бы мы ни взывали к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}}?
ru.R: Ни у одного другого народа, даже самого великого, нет богов, которые были бы так близки к нему, как {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, наш Бог, близок к нам. Он рядом всегда, когда мы зовём {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.

ja.L: 実に、わたしたちが呼び求めるたびに[近くにおられる]わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のように、近くにいる神々を持つ大いなる国民がどこにあるだろうか？
ja.B: わたしたちが呼び求めるとき、いつも近くにいてくださるわたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のように、その神々が近くにいる大いなる国民が、ほかにあるだろうか？
ja.R: どんなに大きな国でも、わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のように、近くにいる神々を持つ国はない。わたしたちが呼び求めるとき、いつでも、この方は近くにいてくださる。

uk.L: Бо який [є] великий народ, що має богів [таких] близьких до нього, як {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, наш Бог, у всякому нашому кликанні до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}?
uk.B: Бо чи є ще великий народ, до якого його боги були б так близько, як {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, наш Бог, до нас, коли ми кличемо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}?
uk.R: Жоден інший народ, хоч який великий, не має богів, які були б так близько до нього, як {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, наш Бог, близько до нас. Він поруч щоразу, коли ми кличемо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}.

id.L: Sebab bangsa besar manakah yang mempunyai allah yang begitu dekat kepadanya seperti {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kita, setiap kali kita berseru kepada-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}?
id.B: Sebab bangsa besar manakah yang mempunyai allah sedekat {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kita, kepada kita setiap kali kita berseru kepada-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}?
id.R: Tidak ada bangsa lain, sebesar apa pun, yang mempunyai allah sedekat {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kita, kepada kita. Dia dekat setiap kali kita berseru kepada-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.

zh.L: 有哪一个大国，有神明离它这么近，就像我们每次向{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}我们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}呼求的时候，{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}离我们那么近呢？
zh.B: 哪一个大国的神明会离它那么近，像{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}我们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}在我们每次呼求{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}时离我们那么近呢？
zh.R: 没有别的国家，不管多么强大，有神明像{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}我们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}那样亲近我们。我们无论什么时候呼求{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}，{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}都在我们身边。

tl.L: Sapagkat anong dakilang bansa [ang mayroon] na may mga diyos na napakalapit dito gaya {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} ating Diyos tuwing tumatawag tayo sa {{deity_pronoun:kaniya|Kaniya}}?
tl.B: Sapagkat anong dakilang bansa ang may mga diyos na kasinglapit dito gaya {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} ating Diyos sa atin tuwing tumatawag tayo sa {{deity_pronoun:kaniya|Kaniya}}?
tl.R: Walang ibang bansa, gaano man kadakila, ang may mga diyos na kasinglapit dito gaya {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} ating Diyos sa atin. Malapit {{deity_pronoun:siya|Siya}} tuwing tumatawag tayo sa {{deity_pronoun:kaniya|Kaniya}}.

pa.L: ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਵੱਡੀ ਕੌਮ [ਹੈ] ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਇੰਨੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਹੋਣ ਜਿਵੇਂ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਸਾਡੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ [ਹਨ] ਜਦ ਵੀ ਅਸੀਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪੁਕਾਰਦੇ ਹਾਂ?
